# identity.CreateApiKeyInput

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Creates an API key; scopes must be within the caller's permissions at the node.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `identity.CreateApiKeyInput` |
| Kind | `command` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.api-key.create` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `expiresAt` | yes | `none` | Required expiry (UTC), after now and at most 365 days ahead. |  |
| `name` | yes | `none` | Name of the key. |  |
| `node` | yes | `none` | Node the key is limited to. |  |
| `scopes` | yes | `none` | Permissions the key may use; always intersected with the owner's current grants. |  |

## Relations

_None._
